t: The $(5)Anti-Friendly Module$() is an optional module for the $(l:mffs:machines/interdiction_matrix)Interdiction Matrix$(). With this module installed, the Matrix will automatically detect friendly entities (like sheep, cows and villagers) that enter its scanning range and kill them - almost instantly. Players and hostile mobs are unharmed.
$(5)反友好生物模块$()是$(l:mffs:machines/interdiction_matrix)干涉矩阵$()的可选模块。安装此模块后，干涉矩阵将自动检测进入其扫描范围的友方实体（如绵羊、牛和村民），并几乎瞬间将其击杀。玩家及敌对生物则不受影响。
